about.title: About Argueta CPA Firm
text: Welcome to Argueta CPA Firm, your trusted partner in accounting and financial services. Established in 2014, we are a dynamic and forward-thinking firm located in the heart of Downtown Houston.
With our expertise and dedication, we provide a comprehensive range of services tailored to meet the unique needs of clients in the nonprofit, governmental organizations, and small businesses.

At Argueta CPA Firm, we understand the challenges and complexities that organizations in these sectors face. That is why we specialize in delivering top-notch accounting services, consulting services, and assurance services to empower our clients with the financial insights and strategies needed to thrive in their respective fields.
